claim_summary: For every irrational Sturmian slope and every standard symbolic metric parameter \(0<\theta<1\), empirical orbit measures converge uniformly to the Sturmian measure at rate at most \(1/[n(1-\theta)^3]\), while the uniform orbit-matching pseudometric is bounded below by \(1/n\) and above by \(2/[n(1-\theta)^3]\). Thus the quantitative unique-ergodicity scale is exactly \(n^{-1}\) in order.
integrity: The proof uses the source's explicit Lipschitz cohomological decomposition and norm bounds, exact Sturmian balance, Wasserstein duality, and the Birkhoff--von Neumann permutation representation for equal-weight empirical measures. No finite experiment or external certification is used as proof.
scientific_limitations: The statement is intrinsic to the one-sided Sturmian subshift with the specified standard symbolic metric. It does not claim a sharp multiplicative constant, an ambient beta-shift rate, a periodic-orbit approximation rate in a larger shift, or an extension to non-Lipschitz observables.
title: Sharp inverse-time quantitative equidistribution on Sturmian subshifts
